objects.name: PORT DETAIL | single industrial precinct surface

diagnosis: Terrain was physically cut out under slab, but its open edge remained 3.4-7.1 metres above the slab. The gap reveals distant textured scenery as a bright strip; no terrain/slab overlap exists at this boundary.
repair: Fit actual adjoining terrain edge to slab and grade adjoining soil to original elevations. Rendered A/B keeps the original boundary footprint, exposing no strip after repair.
fixture: Original-footprint controlled ground repair; source scene retained unchanged
ray_limit: Geometric rays start immediately before gap and include render-hidden source objects; they establish open space, not final composited color ownership.
proof: Controlled 1920x1080 start/mid/end repair renders remove the strip without moving the precinct boundary or hiding objects.
